objective: Establish the 2027 SOTA technical specifications, architectural trade-offs, and empirical benchmark baselines across enterprise multi-agent distributed systems.

inferences: [INFERENCE] By 2027, enterprise multi-agent architectures will universally standardize on OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions and durable execution backbones (Temporal/Cadence) to ensure audit compliance and zero-state-loss recovery.
